description: Ministry of Power & Energy - LED Lamps, Regulations - No. 02 of 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Power & Energy under the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority Act, establishing energy performance standards for LED lamps.
